help.title: How-to Guide
help.subtitle: A summary of {{brandEn}}'s basic operations and how to invite customers
help.section1Intro: Access each feature from the left menu (PC) / bottom nav (mobile).
help.section1ClientsDesc: : Check participating customers, assign plans, view training history, meal records, body composition, and booking status, make bookings on their behalf, etc.
help.section1ScheduleDesc: : Check the booking list, block time slots (fill in closures, ongoing sessions, etc.), and create bookings on behalf.
help.section1ExerciseDesc: : Register and edit the master list of exercises customers can choose in their training records.
help.section1AnnouncementDesc: : Create and deliver announcements shown in customers' apps.
help.section1CounselingDesc: : A list of responses from trial and counseling forms.
help.section1MessageDesc: : One-on-one chat with customers. New messages show a notification badge on the header icon.
help.section2Intro2: (or invite link). A unique code is automatically issued for each gym.
help.section2Step1Desc: You can copy the code or invite link ({{path}}) from the "Invite code" card in gym settings.
help.section2Step2Desc: Share it with customers by LINE, email, in person, or any method. Sending the invite link saves them input effort and is more reliable.
help.section2Step3Desc: Customers open the invite link in their smartphone browser (Safari/Chrome, etc.). If you gave the code verbally, they open the {{brandEn}} site and enter it via "Join a gym".
help.section2Step4Desc: Unregistered customers set an email and password on the spot to sign up. No email confirmation is needed; they can use it right after registering.
help.section2Step5: Enter a display name to finish joining
help.section2Step5Desc: After confirming the gym name, tap "Join" and enter a display name (the name shown to the owner) to complete registration.
help.section2Step6: Guidance to add to home screen (optional)
help.section2Step6Desc: An "Add to Home Screen" prompt appears in the customer's app. Adding it lets them launch it like an app for greater convenience.
help.section3Title: 3. What customers can do in the app
help.section3Item1: Book/cancel sessions and check booking status and remaining sessions
help.section3Item2: Enter training records (exercise, sets, weight, reps) and view progress charts
help.section3Item3: Photo-record meals with automatic AI nutrient analysis
help.section3Item4: Record body composition such as weight and body fat, with progress charts
help.section3Item5: Posture analysis (body type & posture check from a photo)
help.section3Item7: One-on-one chat with the owner and view announcements from the gym
help.section4Item1Desc: : It may not work correctly in the in-app browser of a customer's messaging app. Guide them to "Open in Safari" or "Open in Chrome".
help.section4Item2Desc: : An email already participating in another gym cannot join a different gym with the same account.
help.section4Item3Desc: : Codes are matched ignoring case and hyphens, but full-width digits or extra spaces will cause failure.
help.section4Item4Desc: : Slots won't appear if business hours or slot duration aren't set in gym settings. Also check that you haven't added too many blocks on the schedule screen.
help.section4Item5Desc: : Exceeding your plan's customer limit restricts new bookings and record additions. It's lifted by changing your plan or reducing customers.
help.section5Title: 5. How to subscribe to a plan
help.section5Intro: {{brandEn}}'s paid plans can be subscribed to from the web admin screen. Log in with the same account as the app.
help.section5Step1Desc: Open {{url}} in your smartphone or PC browser and log in with the same email and password as the app.
help.section5Step2Desc: From "Gym Settings" in the admin screen, select the "Plans & Billing" section.
help.section5Step3: Choose a plan and billing cycle
help.section5Step3Desc: Choose your desired plan from Starter / Standard / Pro, and select monthly or yearly (2 months free).
help.section5Step4Desc: Follow the on-screen guidance to enter your credit card details and complete the payment. Billing info and receipts can be checked later in the customer portal.
help.section5Step5Desc: After subscribing, it's reflected in the app's "Current Plan" display. This may take a few minutes.
help.section5NoticeDesc: : Plan changes and cancellations can be done from the web customer portal. The app is view-only.

privacy.s3Body: 当社は、取得した個人情報を、利用目的の達成に必要な範囲を超えて利用しません。
privacy.s4Title: 4. 第三者提供および外部サービスへの委託・連携

privacy.s4P2: ただし、本アプリの提供に必要な範囲で、以下の外部サービスにデータ処理を委託または連携する場合があります。

privacy.s4Item4: OpenAI API等：AIによる姿勢分析、食事内容の推定補助

deleteAccount.title: About Deleting Your Account
deleteAccount.intro: In the gymboard app, you can delete your account yourself. Please follow one of the methods below.
deleteAccount.inAppTitle: How to delete within the app
deleteAccount.inAppStep1: Log in to the gymboard app.
deleteAccount.inAppStep2: Open "Settings" from the menu at the bottom of the screen.
deleteAccount.inAppStep3: Tap the "Delete Account" button at the very bottom of the Settings screen.
deleteAccount.inAppStep4: Select "Delete" in the confirmation dialog to delete your account.
deleteAccount.ownerBody: A gym owner's account cannot be deleted while a gym registration remains. Please delete the gym first, or transfer it to another owner before deleting your account.
deleteAccount.noAccessTitle: If you can't access the app
deleteAccount.noAccessBody: If you've already uninstalled the app or can't log in, please send an account deletion request to the email address below. After identity verification, we will handle the deletion.
deleteAccount.requestNote: Use the subject "gymboard account deletion request" and include your registered name and email address in the body.
deleteAccount.dataIntro: When your account is deleted, the following data will be deleted or anonymized.
deleteAccount.dataItem1: Profile information (name, email, phone number, date of birth, gender, etc.)
deleteAccount.dataItem2: Body information (height, weight, body fat percentage, etc.)
deleteAccount.dataItem6: Posture analysis results and posture photos
deleteAccount.dataItem9: Google integration info, LINE integration info
deleteAccount.dataNote: Except for retention periods required by law or business, we will delete or anonymize data within a reasonable period. Deleted data cannot be restored.
deleteAccount.noticeItem1: Once you delete your account, you cannot reuse the same data again.
deleteAccount.noticeItem2: If you're on a paid plan, please complete cancellation before deleting.
deleteAccount.noticeItem3: If you have any questions, please contact the email address above.
